name: responder
summary: A LLMNR and NBT-NS poisoner, with built-in HTTP/SMB/MSSQL/FTP/LDAP rogue authentication server supporting NTLMv1/NTLMv2/LMv2 (multirelay version).
highlights: -A — Analyze mode. See requests without poisoning. (passive)
-e — Poison with a different IPv4 address than Responder's.
--rdnss — Poison via Router Advertisements with RDNSS. Sets attacker as IPv6 DNS.
--dnssl — Poison via Router Advertisements with DNSSL. Injects DNS search suffix.
-t — Set TTL for poisoned answers. Hex value (30s = 1e) or 'random'.
-N — Canonical name in LLMNR answers. (for Kerberos relay over HTTP)
-d — Enable DHCPv4 poisoning. Injects WPAD in DHCP responses.
-D — Inject DNS server (not WPAD) in DHCPv4 responses.
